summary: Kounalakis's documented Gaza actions lean Israel-centric: she attended an October 2023 California Capitol rally with Jewish and interfaith leaders calling for hostage release, and in May 2024 publicly criticized California universities for their handling of Palestinian student protests. Vote for Peace, a human-rights and war-lobby-funding rating guide, opposed her in the general election. CAIR Action preferred her—a tier below full endorsement—offering a partial counter-signal to the documented pattern.
